{{Quote|Muh ''first number'' is about ''courage!'' It's ''not'' dedicated to all the ''spineless rejects'' who just ''watch'' the Boonta!|Boles Roor|<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
'''Boles Roor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]], a professional and successful [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]], and a famous [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], known for his strong voice and his daredevil driving. Initially combining both pursuits, this Sneevel became a star in each profession, singing in the [[Kallarak Amphitheater]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and winning the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] twice. He was considered a living legend, although not one without detractors. He eventually decided to concentrate on his [[Music/Legends|musical]] vocation, but returned to sports at least twice on special occasions. Although by then his critics thought Roor's Podracing skills were not at their best, his performance was surprisingly good. When racing, Roor favored a [[Bin Gassi Racing Engines]] [[Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E engine|Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E]], even after the model had become obsolete.

==Biography==
===Origins===
[[File:BolesRoor-PodracingTales.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Boles Roor, celebrity]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]], Boles Roor was an accomplished [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]],<ref name="DB" /> commonly racing in non-protective clothing.<ref name="carta">{{YJCCG|set=Boonta Eve Podrace|cardname=Boles Roor|link=boontaevepodrace/light/large/11bolesroorpodracerpilot.html}}</ref> He was known to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] his [[Bin Gassi Racing Engines]] [[Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E engine|Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E]] pod.<ref name="DB" /> His high-output machine with modified [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] could reach 790 [[Kilometer/Legends|km/h]], and Roor could control it at that speed.<ref name="DB" /> Roor was the track favorite of the [[Zugga Challenge/Legends|Zugga Challenge]] on the planet [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]],<ref name="racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref> and during his career he twice won the prestigious [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DB" /> Critics, however, attributed his victories less to any real talent and more to sheer luck.<ref name="DBpod">{{DB|vehicle|bolesroorspodracer|Podracer, Boles Roor's}}</ref>

Roor, who regarded himself a crooner before a racer, concentrated on his vocation as a [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]], achieving a successful career.<ref name="DB" /> While Roor raced in full clothes,<ref name="carta" /> he was naked when singing or casual.<ref name="PT" /> Half-retired from Podracing by the time the highly-successful [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] started in the sport, Roor instead sang in distinguished venues such as the [[Kallarak Amphitheater]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a million-seat hall that regularly sold out for each performance.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

Neglecting his vehicle's upkeep, Roor hired a crew of [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tibs]] to perform [[Technician/Legends|maintenance]] tasks while he was singing.<ref name="DBpod" /> At some point, he also hired [[Shrivel Braittrand]], a [[Kulless]], as his chief mechanic.<ref name="RR">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref> Even with their work, the pod began to suffer: its dual combustion chambers failed to cool properly,<ref name="racer" /><ref name="DBpod" /> its internal components were replaced by sub-par substitutes when needed, and the soldered seams were of poor quality.<ref name="DBpod" /> The racer also had low quality welding in its left [[Engine/Legends|engine]].<ref name="ep1vd">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

===Boonta Eve Classic, 32 BBY===
{{Quote|It's two-time winner Boles Roor. This Sneevel's got money to burn, and he's put it all in his Podracer.|Beed|audio=BolesRoorAnnounce.flac|<ref name="racer" />}}
After an important leave from the Podracing pro circuit, Roor returned to the Boonta Eve Classic for the race of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> He was not the only old-timer in the race, but both his vehicle and his skills had grown rusty, and the racing scene had evolved without his knowing. Even then, Roor refused to replace his out-of-date pod.<ref name="ep1vd" />

[[File:BolesRoor_podracer.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Boles Roor's podracer]]
The day before the race, Roor and some of the Boonta Eve favorites, including the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]], the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]], and Sebulba, were featured in the [[Fode and Beed Show/Legends|Fode and Beed Show]], the talk show of race commentator [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]. Sebulba taunted each of his challengers during the program, with Roor being the only one to reply to him. Roor also announced a glimmik performance for that same night during the show.<ref name="PT" /> While on Tatooine, Roor patronized the food stand operated by [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]], the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Gorg/Legends|gorgmonger]].<ref name="JJJ">''[[Star Wars: Jar Jar's Journey Adventure Book]]''.</ref>

On the night before the Boonta, Roor gave his glimmik show in the [[Poodoo Lounge]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. During his act, Roor arrogantly and noisily taunted the rookie [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]], wagering five million [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] that a cowardly Toong like Quadinaros wouldn't enter the race. To everybody's surprise, including himself, Quadinaros accepted.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="PT" /><ref name="DBquad">{{DB|character|benquadinaros|Quadinaros, Ben}}</ref> Roor avoided public embarrassment by dedicating his first song to Quadinaros, and continued with a loud concert.<ref name="PT" />

In the Boonta Race, Roor was upset to see Quadinaros in the eighteenth starting block from Roor's own tenth post.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="TPM" /> By then, his bet with the Toong was public knowledge. However, Quadinaros's quickly-rented [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310 quadra-Podracer]] was sabotaged by another pilot, [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]], who was trying to damage [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|vehicle]].<ref name="PT" /> As a result, Quadinaros never advanced past the starting block, nevertheless winning his bet.<ref name="TPM" />

Meanwhile, Roor was racing at high speed.<ref name="PT" /> He finished the race in sixth place, with a total time of 16:42:473 and an average speed of 781 km/h.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="IE1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> His rival Sebulba did not even finish the race, as he crashed before reaching the finish, while the victory went to the young Skywalker.<ref name="TPM" /> During a party after the race, Roor's bet with Quadinaros was the talk of the pilots.<ref name="PT" /> Roor was disgruntled, but promptly paid Quadinaros his money.<ref name="DB" />

===Later career===
To compensate for his losses during the Boonta Eve Classic of 32 BBY, Roor put Podracing back on the shelf and took a tour around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] performing glimmik. In this period of time, he gave his pod to his chief mechanic Braittrand, who modified the racer, and used it in further competitions.<ref name="RR" />

[[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years after the race]], Roor had became a legend on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Sneeve. He abandoned his retirement to publicly support [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jollin Resbin]] of Sneeve, a proponent of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Roor appeared in a series of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] endorsements and ran in charity races in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] to spread Resbin's message in the area. He was scheduled to run in the [[Dasoor Challenge/Legends|Dasoor Challenge]] the same day of the final vote on the Act, weather permitting.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've seen better parts at a junk market!|Boles Roor|translated=1|audio=BolesRoor-taunt.flac|<ref name="racer" />}}
[[File:Boles_roor.jpg|thumb|left|Boles Roor during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]]]
At 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="DB" /> Boles Roor was relatively short for a Sneevel, who commonly ranged from 1.6 to 2.1 meters in height.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Like many others of his [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="AA" /> Roor was shaggy and gave off a pungent smell that was one of his personal trademarks.<ref name="DB" /> Another was his powerful voice, which he used to his advantage in his singing career.<ref name="DB" /> He was a talented musician whose performing flair made him quite wealthy.<ref name="EIRPSG ">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> When singing glimmik, Roor played a pink instrument with a long neck that he carried nonchalantly.<ref name="PT" />

Many Sneevels felt a need for thrill. Roor was not the only one of his species who resorted to dangerous sports as a way of life.<ref name="AA" /> Although a capable, awarded pilot in his prime,<ref name="DB" /> recognized as such by critics, Roor's Podracing skills were less competitive by comparison as of 32 BBY, as the pilots he raced against had faster reflexes and the podracing circuit had changed since his times.<ref name="ep1vd" /><ref name="sot">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' offers RPG podracing statistics for Roor and other pilots as of the 32 BBY Boonta Eve Classic. Roor's are far below the mean, although he has a comparatively good vehicle in certain areas. Roor's skills are also surprisingly low for what could be expected of a Sneevel pro pilot, considering the high Dextery bonus for Sneevels (although statistics for Sneevels were not released until five months later than ''Secrets of Tatooine'', in ''[[Alien Anthology]]'').</ref> As such, Roor was never considered to be a main contender to win the Boonta Eve Classic and was generally regarded as a second-rate pilot in comparison to the likes of Sebulba and Gasgano.<ref name="PtF">''[[Episode I Adventures 14: Podrace to Freedom]]''</ref> Nevertheless, Roor considered Podracing little more than a hobby, finding much more interest in his vocation as a musician.<ref name="DB" />

For the Boonta Eve Race of 32 BBY, Roor chose to use his old Bin Gassi Racing Engines Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E, even when other, newer and better models were available; Roor was criticized for this decision.<ref name="ep1vd" /> Nevertheless, the racer's expensive price tag allowed Roor to show off his wealth.<ref name="EIRPSG " /> Although most Podracer pilots were also the primary mechanics of their own vehicles as of 32 BBY, at that point Roor had low skills in that field relative to his rivals'.<ref name="DBpod" /><ref name="st">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> Rather, Roor hired a crew of other beings to maintain his pod.<ref name="DBpod" /><ref name="RR" /> When piloting, Roor wore clothes,<ref name="carta" /> something he did not do when performing glimmik.<ref name="PT" />

Roor's arrogance and bluster showed itself the night before the Boonta Eve in the Poodoo Lounge when he taunted Ben Quadinaros into accepting a five-million-peggat bet that the former would not enter the race. Roor was subsequently embarrassed by Quadinaros's acceptance of the challenge.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Podrace_announcers.png|thumb|right|250px|Boles Roor's face is seen briefly in ''Episode I'' on a racing screen, right of the announcer.]]
The character Boles Roor was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> and first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 2|second issue]] of the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace (comic series)|comic adaptation]] as one of the Podracers participating in Tatooine's Boonta Eve Classic.<ref name="TPM comic" /> Notably, however, Roor is never clearly visible on-screen in ''The Phantom Menace'' film. When the Boonta Eve race announcer calls his name, only his Podracer's empty cockpit is seen.<ref name="DB" /> However, his face can be seen briefly on a screen during a previous scene in which the announcer welcomes the audience.<ref name="TPM" />

During the film's development stages, Boles Roor was first known as "Shaggy Podracer" in the character's original ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' concept sketches by artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]].<ref name="DB" /><ref name="Hyperspace-Galactic Gallery: Just Call Him Shaggy">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/galactic/2006/09/galactic20060922.html|series=Galactic Gallery|text=Just Call Him Shaggy}} (referenced at {{Blogspot|subdomain=thedweebletter|url=2006_09_24_archive.html|name=The Dweebletter|text=Weekly Archive (article: MORE Star Wars stuff)}})</ref> Boles Roor's character was voiced by [[Peter Lurie]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="racer" />

The revised rough draft of ''The Phantom Menace'' mentions the Podracer Boles Roor, from a planet named "Ord Padrove." The name of the planet may have evolved to [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']], Gasgano's podracer.<ref name="DBboonta">{{DB|organization|boontapodrace|Boonta Eve Classic Podracers}}</ref>

Roor appears in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: Jar Jar's Journey Adventure Book]]'', released in [[1999]] by [[Lucas Learning]], during a mini-game that takes place at Gragra the gorgmonger's stand. In the game, Roor is one of a series of patrons who approach the stand and order some food item in rhyme. The player must then select the correct order from a list of pictures to please the customer. Roor in the game is voiced by [[Peter Lurie]].<ref name="JJJ" />
